prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1475; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a report of a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas. On arrival, Driver 1 and Driver 2 were standing beside their vehicles, and Passenger was seated in the front of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a knee injury and said the knee struck the dashboard during the impact. Driver 2 stated that the vehicles collided after both drivers slowed for traffic ahead. Officers reviewed scene photographs, which confirm the positions of both vehicles and the location of the damage. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with the impact described by the drivers. Passenger and Driver 1 were both present in the vehicle at the time of the collision, as confirmed by officers on scene and by statements from the parties involved. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. No prior damage to either vehicle was reported or observed. Whether the reported knee injury resulted from this collision has not yet been determined and will require further medical review.
